title: Open the curved master grid's sparse end so fillDensity 1..50 changes the picture (F-01)
notes: Root cause: surface-fill.js's masterPitch = min(tonePitch, o6Pitch) picked the density-free o6Pitch constant (~1.51mm) for every Density 1-49 on curved primitives, because hatchSpacing's own taper never got finer than it until ~Density 49.5 -- Density, not the floor, only started to matter at 50. Fix: o6Pitch is rescaled by max(1, tonePitch/o6Pitch0) so it tracks tonePitch instead of clamping flat once density asks to be sparser (byte-identical at and above the crossover, i.e. Density >= ~50); scene3d.js's new curvedSparseTonePitch widens hatchSpacing's shallow 1.85x taper below Density 50 into a geometric decay converging exactly to the untouched formula at Density 50, giving enough separation in ruling count to survive the ladder's own per-band rounding noise at low counts. Visually: Density 1 ("low") now renders 4-6 sparse rulings/bands instead of the same dense pattern used at Density 50 ("med"), on sphere+hatch+ladder, torus+contour+ladder, cone+spiral+ladder, and the ribbon-ish sphere+hatch+taperedEnds and torus+hatch+bundleCount. Density 50 ("med") is pixel-for-pixel unchanged in every pair. Numbers: sphere/hatch/ladder path count 1/25/50/100 = 22/22/23/50 before, 5/9/23/50 after; torus/contour/ladder before was flat at low/med until 50 (12-ish/64/146 unaffected shape), after = 12/31/64/146; cone/spiral/ladder after = 12/29/62 across 1/25/50.
